references.title: 勞動基準法 §24(1): 延長工作時間在二小時以內者，按平日每小時工資額加給三分之一以上；再延長工作時間在二小時以內者，加給三分之二以上 — each working day’s overtime: the time recorded past the planned shift’s hours in completed half-hours, less any banked as 補休 (work.days[].overtime_hours), the first two at 1⅓ and every further hour at 1⅔ of the hourly wage (monthly wage incl. regular allowances ÷ 30 ÷ 8). §24(1)(3): 依第三十二條第四項規定，延長工作時間者，按平日每小時工資額加倍發給 — not priced: no roster fact marks a §32(4) day in work.days. Within the §32 limits it is not taxable salary (所得稅法 §14(1)(3)).
勞動基準法 §24
references.quote: 按平日每小時工資額加給三分之一以上…加給三分之二以上

description: Working-day overtime: the hourly wage × 1⅓ for each day’s first two overtime hours and × 1⅔ for every further hour (勞基法 §24(1)).

references.title: 勞動基準法 §40(1): 因天災、事變或突發事件…停止第三十六條至第三十八條所定勞工之假期。但停止假期之工資，應加倍發給，並應於事後補假休息 — one further day’s wage for each worked day whose shift is REST (the §36 例假); the rest in lieu is STATUTORY_REST_IN_LIEU. Work on a 例假 outside §40 is unlawful but its wage is still owed.

description: A 例假 worked: one further day’s wage for each such day (an hourly worker: their hours up to normal hours), or the employer’s rest-day multiple where it pays more (勞基法 §40).

references.title: 勞動基準法 §24(2): 雇主使勞工於第三十六條所定休息日工作，工作時間在二小時以內者，其工資按平日每小時工資額另再加給一又三分之一以上；工作二小時後再繼續工作者，按平日每小時工資額另再加給一又三分之二以上 — hours three to eight at 1⅔ and, on the Ministry of Labor reading that the monthly wage already holds eight rest-day hours, the ninth to twelfth at 2⅔ (law-audit decision 2026-11-13, superseding the two-tier decision of 2026-11-06). Priced on the hours actually worked — all of the day’s recorded time in completed half-hours, less any banked as 補休, counted from the first hour (the minimum-count rule was deleted 2018-03-01) on a day whose shift is OFF, the TW 休息日 (shift_definition.variant.day_type OFF; REST is the §36 例假).
勞動基準法 §24

references.quote: 前2小時另再加給1又1/3，第3至8小時另再加給1又2/3，第9至12小時另再加給2又2/3

description: Work on a 休息日: the hourly wage × 1⅓ for the first two hours, × 1⅔ to the eighth and × 2⅔ from the ninth (勞基法 §24(2), MOL reading), or the employer’s rest-day multiple where it pays more.

references.title: 勞動基準法 §39: 休假日…工作者，工資應加倍發給 — one further day’s wage (monthly wage ÷ 30) for each published holiday actually worked; a holiday not worked is already in the monthly salary. 改制前勞委會 87年9月14日(87)台勞動二字第039675號函: hours beyond eight follow §24 (HOLIDAY_OVERTIME).

description: A published holiday worked: one further day’s wage for each such day; an hourly worker is paid their hours up to normal hours (勞基法 §39).

references.title: 勞動基準法 §39 with §24(1): paid hours on a holiday beyond the eighth and past the planned shift (on a planned rest or off day, every recorded hour after the eighth), less any banked as 補休, at 1.34 for the first two and 1.67 after (改制前勞委會 87年9月14日(87)台勞動二字第039675號函; 高雄市勞工局 115年休假日一覽表 附註三). They count toward the §32 monthly overtime ceiling.

description: Hours past the shift on a published holiday (past the eighth on a planned off day): the hourly wage × 1⅓ for the first two and × 1⅔ after (勞基法 §39, §24(1)).
